content.overview: No person shall issue, circulate or distribute in India any prospectus offering for subscription in securities of a company incorporated or to be incorporated outside India, whether or not it has established or will establish a place of business in India, unless before such issue, circulation or distribution a copy of the prospectus certified by the chairperson of the company and two other directors as having been approved by resolution of the managing body has been delivered for registration to the Registrar and the prospectus states on its face that a copy has been so delivered.
content.glance: Before issuing a foreign-company prospectus in India, a copy certified by the chairperson and two other directors (approved by the managing body) must be delivered to the Registrar for registration.
content.study: Section 389 makes registration a condition of issuing, circulating or distributing in India a prospectus for securities of a company incorporated or to be incorporated outside India. A copy must be certified by the chairperson and two other directors as approved by the managing body and delivered to the Registrar before issue. The prospectus must state on its face that a copy has been delivered. The section applies whether or not the company has a place of business in India.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: A foreign-company prospectus may not be issued in India until a copy certified by the chairperson and two other directors is delivered to the Registrar for registration.

examples.title: Illustration — s. 389
examples.body: Before circulating a foreign-company prospectus in India, the issuer delivers a copy certified by the chairperson and two directors to the Registrar under s. 389.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 389?
hypotheticals.analysis: It requires pre-issue delivery to the Registrar of a certified copy of a foreign-company prospectus before Indian circulation.

misconceptions.trap: Treating post-issue filing as sufficient under s. 389.
misconceptions.correction: s. 389 requires delivery for registration before issue, circulation or distribution in India.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 389 be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Confirm Indian issue of a foreign-company prospectus. II. Check pre-issue certified delivery to the Registrar. III. Confirm face statement of delivery.

revisionPoints: Foreign prospectus — pre-issue delivery of certified copy to Registrar; face statement of delivery
